newsitem.title: UK: LME copper up, zinc at fresh highs in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper up, zinc at fresh highs in late trading.

text.p: LME copper took a look at the upside in late trading on Wednesday and zinc spurted to fresh 4-1/2 year highs.
At 1800 GMT three months copper was indicated at $2,427/29 per tonne versus the kerb close of $2,414, which was down $3 from the previous finish.
Traders said short covering out of the United States had triggered stops and set off a bout of buying in copper and other industrial metals.
The late blip higher followed a generally lacklustre day amid thin volumes.
Zinc, which had been the best performer earlier with a $2 firmer kerb close of $1,339, progressed to fresh 4-1/2 year highs in late trading.
Dealers said it traded as high as $1,345 and would next target the $1,350 resistance level.
Aluminium also ticked higher and was indicated at $1,666/68 after a $14 weaker close of $1,656.
